verbal_intervention.headline: FOMC meeting DAY 1 underway (decision Wed t-1); hike-odds band EASES post-CPI - Polymarket 55% hike / 39% hold, cross-venue ~78% after 81.3% post-CPI peak; Trump repeats 'world's lowest rates' demand into the vote

The 'no-win vote' frame stands (a president's appointee voting to hike over the president's explicit objection), with Trump repeating Sunday that the US should have the world's lowest interest rate. verbal_intervention.headline: Trump pivots the Iran track verbal: 'Iran is eager and in a hurry' for a deal, predicts oil drop after midterms, demands US compensation for Hormuz escort services; Tehran rules out talks for now
verbal_intervention.source: Gate News Xinhua (Sep 14 20:52Z) / Seoul Economic Daily (Sep 14 08:46Z) / Express Tribune + newkerala (Sep 15) / AnewZ 'Tehran rejects talks' / aINVEST post-midterms oil-drop frame (Sep 12) - fresh

Double-edged rung: a named near-term negotiation track exists for the first time in the window, but the escort-compensation demand adds a new material precondition and the election-dated framing pushes resolution past the midterms.

anonymous_leaks.headline: CARRIED: Reuters sources - BOJ set to lift rates next week but offer few clues on terminal rate; Reuters poll: 1.25% this month, 1.75% reached faster than expected

The faster-than-expected path to 1.75% is the yen-carry-unwind vector: each rung drains the carry trade that has funded global risk assets.

Official-vs-official contradiction is itself the signal - Riyadh is managing the timeline narrative while the physical outage persists.

central_bank_communication.headline: ECB KAZAKS: 'growing case for more tightening' - second-day follow-through on the Sep 10 25bp hike to 2.50%; France-Germany 10y spread 92.85bp highest since July 2012; Lagarde inflation warning deepens the bond rout

central_bank_communication.headline: BOJ t-3 with hike locked: ING preview '25bp hike incoming', market near-pricing a further hike by year-end; money-market rates surged since June; 155 seen as USD/JPY upside cap

The hand layer's china_collapse ACTIVE rests on this divergence: currency defended by state will, domestic demand still eroding, stimulus question open.

geopolitical_posture.headline: Salalah Iran-Gulf foreign ministers meeting SHELVED - Iran says Saudi requested postponement facing Houthi/Iraqi-militia threats; Oman: 'conditions not right'; Tehran continues seeking a regionally-backed reopening bill; NO NEW DATE

convergence.methodology: raw_score = sum(imminence x impact) over tagged findings; convergence_score = min(100, round(raw x 0.17) + 5x(categories_beyond_2)); >=100 ACTIVE, >=50 DEVELOPING, else WATCH (formal layer). Hand layer (0-200 composite, confirmed-state rule) maintained separately in blackwatch-macro-event.json and untouched by this scan. De-escalation ticks carry no thread tags (v2.1).
